suggested_subject_line: who answers 'Talk with Glen' at 9pm?
personalized_first_line: Your homepage says 'Free Case Review - 24/7, Talk with Glen'; your contact page says Mon-Fri 9 to 5. Curious what covers that gap at 9pm.
call_angle: Missed-call / after-hours bilingual intake is the wedge; the free GEO audit is the door-opener. Acknowledge he already pays for calls (CallRail tracking, Meta pixel, an ads agency) and that the site promises 24/7 in four languages with one attorney and three staff on a 9-to-5 office line. E4L's receptionist, trained on his own site, answers every missed or after-hours call, runs an empathetic intake (date of injury, treatment, insurer, no legal advice) in English or Spanish, books the consult, and texts back every missed call in under a minute - the caller never reaches the next firm on Google. Proof lever: a demo line built from howardinjurylaw.com he can call before paying anything. Respect his Intaker chat: it handles web chat/text, not the ringing phone. Never promise case volume or outcomes.
likely_objection: 'We're already covered 24/7 - we have Intaker chat and texting, and clients can reach me on my cell.' Answer: chat and text catch the people who type; the voice agent catches the ones who dial at 9pm and get voicemail, and it drops them into the same intake - go-live is one conditional call-forwarding rule on missed/busy calls. Second objection: 'We already have an agency (Storm Media) doing SEO and GEO' - the audit is free, show the screenshots, do not bash the agency; pivot to the phone. Third (PI-specific): 'I get pitched by marketing guys every day' - lead with the demo number and one verifiable observation, not a pitch.
why_now: He is investing in traffic right now - eight blog posts updated Oct 12-13, 2026, a Spanish video campaign and /es/ landing pages, call tracking and a Meta pixel on the site - so more ad-driven and organic calls are landing on a single-attorney firm whose published after-hours plan is a chat widget and the owner's cell.
